import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem finite_normalCore_greatest {G : Type*} [Group G] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (H : ι → Subgroup G) :
    (⨅ i, (H i).normalCore).Normal ∧
      (⨅ i, (H i).normalCore = (⨅ i, H i).normalCore) ∧
      (∀ i, (⨅ j, (H j).normalCore) ≤ H i) ∧
      ∀ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal → (∀ i, N ≤ H i) →
        N ≤ ⨅ i, (H i).normalCore := by
  have hnormal : (⨅ i, (H i).normalCore).Normal :=
    Subgroup.normal_iInf_normal (fun i => (H i).normalCore_normal)
  
  letI : (⨅ i, (H i).normalCore).Normal := hnormal
  
  have hdist : (⨅ i, H i).normalCore = ⨅ i, (H i).normalCore := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine le_iInf (fun i => ?_)
      exact Subgroup.normalCore_mono (iInf_le H i)
    · apply Subgroup.normal_le_normalCore.mpr
      exact le_iInf (fun i => le_trans (iInf_le _ i) (H i).normalCore_le)
  
  have hcandidate : ∀ i, (⨅ j, (H j).normalCore) ≤ H i := by
    intro i
    exact le_trans (iInf_le _ i) (H i).normalCore_le
  
  have hmax : ∀ N : Subgroup G, N.Normal → (∀ i, N ≤ H i) →
      N ≤ ⨅ i, (H i).normalCore := by
    intro N hN hNH
    letI : N.Normal := hN
    rw [← hdist]
    apply Subgroup.normal_le_normalCore.mpr
    exact le_iInf (fun i => hNH i)
  
  exact ⟨hnormal, hdist.symm, hcandidate, hmax⟩

log.message: All goals closed.
